messages:
devon: FYI pushed firewall hardening for CVE-2026-04 into eu-prod at 2026-03-18T09:12Z. Immediately saw keystore egress to keystore-priv (10.4.5.23:443) drop to RSTs; warm pool nodes failing to join.
ops-bot: Alert: keystore-decrypt errors spiked in eu-west-1 — ~47 nodes NotReady. Creating incident INC-2026-045.
maria: Confirmed the change removed an SNI exception. The HSM endpoint is being blocked by the new rule.
sara: Full rollback re-exposes the CVE. Can we make a scoped exception to restore capacity?
devon: Plan: add a temporary explicit outbound allow for keystore-priv subnet (10.4.5.0/24) in EU firewall chain + whitelist NAT healthchecks. Deploy to prod with 3-node staging canary first.
oncall: Approved for emergency exception. Ensure sec signoff and audit trail.
maria: Applying targeted allow now.
```
# terraform
terraform apply -target=module.firewall_rule.allow_keystore_eu -auto-approve
```
devon: Keystore decrypts returning OK in logs. Join backlog decreasing.
maria: kubectl node status in eu-west: NotReady count went 47 -> 20 -> 5 over ~15m. Warm pool filling.
devon: For remaining stragglers we did targeted rejoin: rgwctl rejoin --region eu-west --node-ids <list>.
sara: Cost impact: retries + spot churn estimate ~USD 6.2k for the 4h window; tagging to infra incident budget.
maria: Logged change CHG-2026-987 and attached terraform plan diff + flow logs. Runbook stub: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/keystore-egress-firewall
oncall: Action items: devon document ACL lines; sara add staging reachability test; maria draft postmortem + attach audit logs. Tagging @olivia (sec).
olivia (sec): Request flow log dump, approver name, TTL for exception, and justification. Keep exception short-lived and schedule re-review.
devon: Added approver metadata and timestamps to CHG-2026-987; uploaded logs.
maria: Final: last join completed and cluster stable by 09:45 UTC. Tightened alerts still enabled. Scheduling sec review within 48h. Closing incident INC-2026-045.
